project_index.note: Declarations and syntactic calls only; imports do not prove framework use or resolved call relationships.

Secrets.note: Candidates are not tested against services. Placeholders are suppressed. False positives remain possible.

Python.note: Statement-order local flow, aliases and Flask input sources. Branches merge conservatively; bounded plain same-file function calls (depth 4, 100 expansions/file); no execution or runtime reachability proof.

JavaScript.note: Tree-sitter statement-order local variable and sanitizer context; comments and string contents do not trigger code rules. TypeScript and interprocedural data flow are not supported.

Java.note: Tree-sitter local statement-order flow and declared types; no interprocedural flow, Java build or code execution. Deserialization filters require manual review.

HTML.note: HTML and inline JavaScript are parsed without rendering, executing scripts or fetching resources.

Configuration.note: Literal configuration inspection only; environment overrides and runtime behavior are not evaluated. JSON/YAML locations are file-level line 1.

Dependencies.note: Only exact declared or locked versions are queried; unsupported formats are explicitly listed; no dependency installation, transitive resolution or guessing of version ranges. Unknown advisory severity is Informational. Private package names/versions are sent to OSV only when enabled.

cases.rationale: Values supplied separately to executemany; fixed SQL structure.
Integer conversion constrains injected SQL syntax; not a general string sanitizer.

cases.rationale: Request-controlled value interpolated into quoted SQL without binding.

cases.rationale: Cross-file helper directly interpolates untrusted name into SQL. This tests a supported-language boundary, not assumed whole-program support.
Fixed executable and separate pattern argument; no shell interpretation.
Documentary text only, never executed.
Joining untrusted data into a shell command retains shell metacharacters.
POSIX single-argument quoting nested inside double quotes is not general shell protection.
Decoded URL data enters HTML parser; attacker HTML could contain event handlers.
Untrusted decoded browser fragment enters document HTML.
Text node creation does not parse HTML.
Standard DOMPurify default contract assumed; sanitized value not altered.
Literal password supplied to recognized imported authentication constructor; synthetic/nonfunctional.
Hardcoded literal assigned to credential configuration; synthetic/nonfunctional.
Public identifier printed, no authentication use or credential structure.
Password loaded at runtime; no hardcoded credential in source.
Fast SHA1 used to derive password digest; no slow salted password KDF.
MD5 explicitly selected for authentication MAC; weak-primitive policy label, not claim of demonstrated forgery.
Non-cryptographic accidental-corruption checksum, no authentication usage.
Explicit nonsecurity hashing for bucket identification; no security decision.
Explicit weak cipher selection, not a checksum.

Fixed query with bound string value.
CRC computes non-security checksum of public bytes.
Explicit placeholder, no real secret-like format.
Direct literal at identified credential API; no variable-name dependency.
Local display method prints a string; does not execute SQL.

ambiguous.rationale: No use/type evidence; credential purpose cannot be labeled from source.
Purpose unspecified; may be nonsecurity checksum or a security digest.
